activeStudies.title: Pre-Operative Anxiety Reduction in Pediatric Patients: A Student Observation Study
activeStudies.description: Observing and documenting non-pharmacological approaches used by clinical staff to reduce pre-operative anxiety in pediatric patients during anesthesia induction at Kibogora Hospital. This study supports SACRA's commitment to evidence-based pediatric anesthesia practice.

activeStudies.title: Compliance Audit: WHO Safe Surgery Checklist in Rusizi District Health Facilities
activeStudies.investigator: Aline Uwera & SACRA Clinical Audit Team
activeStudies.description: A prospective audit assessing adherence to the WHO Safe Surgery Checklist across selected health facilities in Rusizi District, Rwanda. The study identifies gaps in pre-induction verification and documents opportunities for improvement in local anesthesia practice.

activeStudies.title: Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices of Anesthesia Students Regarding Patient Safety
activeStudies.investigator: Jean-Claude Niyonisaba & SACRA Student Research Team
activeStudies.description: A cross-sectional survey study targeting anesthesia students at Kibogora Polytechnic to assess their baseline knowledge, attitudes, and self-reported practices regarding perioperative patient safety protocols.

activeStudies.title: Perioperative Hypothermia Awareness Among Anesthesia Students: A Needs Assessment
activeStudies.description: A needs-assessment study evaluating student awareness of perioperative hypothermia prevention strategies. Findings were used to develop a targeted educational session integrated into SACRA's simulation training program.
